scientific_integrity: All reported asymptotics follow from an analytical reduction, a central-limit boundary layer and an endpoint gamma-tail Laplace argument. The stationary joint law and generic conditional-iid bulk sum law are credited as prior results; included verification is finite testing rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive OU drift, diffusivity and common Poisson reset rate; stationary one-dimensional gas and N-to-infinity edge/fixed-supercritical collective energy tails. No uniform matching, other potentials or independent validation. Full publication priority remains qualified by incomplete supplementary-source coverage.
title: Sharp resetting fingerprints in collective energy tails of a confined Brownian gas
